label: Q01
loop: scoop bills from a giant vault -> feed the shredder for earnings -> upgrade collecting power, tools and backpack -> find rare rainbow cash
objectives: shred as much cash as possible and grow earnings
progression: tool unlocks (bucket, shovel, vacuum), backpack capacity, collect speed, rare cash tiers
instructions: scoop bills, feed the shredder, upgrade power/speed/backpack, unlock tools, bring up to 4 friends

thumbnails: first-person hand feeding cash into a shredder, a vault full of green bills, a rare 1% rainbow bill

label: Q02
loop: collect scrap and parts -> build and upgrade a tank -> survive escalating zombie waves -> earn resources for bigger builds
objectives: survive as many zombie waves as possible with your built vehicle
progression: wave number, tank parts and size
instructions: build a tank, fight to stay alive, don't let the next wave be your last
unique: build-your-own tank combined with zombie wave survival
thumbnails: a blocky multi-gun tank versus zombies; wave 1 go-kart vs wave 100 mega tank
complexity_notes: vehicle building system with attachments, zombie AI waves

label: Q03

objectives: clear the infestation quickly and uncover the story behind it
progression: tools (swatter, sprayer, flamethrower), difficulty tiers, maps, leaderboard times

objectives: run rides cleanly and handle chaos events
progression: level/XP, cash upgrades, new rides, coaster season pass

progression: level unlocks (drink station at L6), recipes, decor, staff, event tiers

objectives: outplay opponents in fast dagger duels
